note: The first byte of attacker-controlled input selects the target architecture/mode; 0x0f routes execution to the SPARC disassembler path.
The selector byte is reduced modulo the platform table length, preserving the SPARC choice for 0x0f.
The remaining bytes are passed as raw instruction stream to Capstone for decoding and pretty-printing.

code: Generated SPARC assembly writer selects operand-specific printers such as printU1ImmOperand and printU2ImmOperand for decoded instructions.
note: Certain SPARC encodings route to immediate-print helpers that forward operand values into the shared numeric formatter.
The operand value is read from the decoded instruction and printed without validating that all bits are initialized.

code: printInt64(O, val) formats the immediate through SStream_concat and ultimately cs_vsnprintf.
note: The uninitialized bits propagate into formatted output, triggering MSan when the formatter consumes the poisoned value.
